text: Prove that the following problem is NP-complete using a reduction from either: Vertex Cover, In- depednent Set, Dominating Set, Subset Sum, Hamiltonian cycle, or Clique. Recall the two steps that are necessary in order to show that a problem is NP complete. A graph G consists of a set of n vertices and m edges. A specific vertex is labelled S. The problem is to determine if there is a simple path that starts at vertex S and visits all other vertices in the graph.
